purpose: Provide a named chart figure and shared state, legend, tooltip and exact-data helpers.
behaviorProvider: Native figure/disclosure/table semantics; shared Skeleton, EmptyState and Button.

component: Render a figure labelled by a generated title ID in a figcaption h3. Forward other figure props while owning this title association.
Choose exactly one plot branch in this order: loading skeleton with named status, truthy error EmptyState, explicit empty EmptyState, or children. Mark the plot aria-busy only while loading.
Show Retry loading only in the error branch when onRetry is provided; activation calls the host callback without changing local state or initiating built-in fetching.
host: Own loading, errors, empty detection, retry requests and meaningful domain copy. The default empty description assumes time-range/filter data and should be assessed for other chart contexts.

requirements.statement: Render a figure labelled by a generated title ID in a figcaption h3. Forward other figure props while owning this title association.
Choose exactly one plot branch in this order: loading skeleton with named status, truthy error EmptyState, explicit empty EmptyState, or children. Mark the plot aria-busy only while loading.
Show Retry loading only in the error branch when onRetry is provided; activation calls the host callback without changing local state or initiating built-in fetching.

Hide legend content during loading/error/empty states. Render a truthy footer independently of those plot states; a supplied data table can therefore remain available beside a loading/error/empty plot.

ChartTooltip returns null unless active with nonempty payload. Format numeric values with the supplied formatter, join array values with a range separator, and use approved semantic datum colors when colorKey matches.
ChartLegend uses labelled non-submitting aria-pressed buttons when onToggle exists, otherwise static labelled swatches. It reports toggle keys and leaves actual hidden state to its caller.

ChartDataTable places a captioned table inside a native details element with a named focusable scroll region. Column/row headers identify values; missing values display an em dash, without calling the chart value formatter.
Own loading, errors, empty detection, retry requests and meaningful domain copy. The default empty description assumes time-range/filter data and should be assessed for other chart contexts.
Consume data-viz group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: The helpers do not validate payloads, fetch data or certify meaningful chart accessibility.
ReactNode slots are conditionally wrapped by truthiness; numeric zero can render as text outside an optional wrapper.
